name: Antigravity CLI (agy)
install: curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh | bash && if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ "$(node -v | cut -d. -f1 | tr -d v)" -lt 22 ]; then curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs; fi && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/Domush/antigravity-plugin-context-mode && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-context && PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin install https://github.com/ahmetdotsh/agy-usage && if [ -d "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/context-mode" ] && [ -d "$HOME/.gemini/config/plugins/antigravity-plugin-context-mode" ]; then PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH" agy plugin uninstall antigravity-plugin-context-mode || true; rm -rf "$HOME/.gemini/antigravity-cli/mcp/antigravity-plugin-context-mode_context-mode"; fi && { ( case "$(uname -m)" in aarch64|arm64) ca=arm64; cs=a36beb2c1965fdec189fd0d740c789922d2ef0dff5295102390bbf612d0f7454 ;; x86_64|amd64) ca=amd64; cs=db9fbd51faa4b5ba614e0fb43b2243ba682421319a55b46f4089f1201b29fab7 ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin"; if [ ! -x "$HOME/.local/bin/chop" ] || [ "$(sha256sum "$HOME/.local/bin/chop" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)" != "$cs" ]; then tmp="$HOME/.local/bin/.chop.tmp.$$"; trap 'rm -f "$tmp"' EXIT; curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 20 --retry 3 --speed-limit 1000 --speed-time 60 "https://github.com/AgusRdz/chop/releases/download/v1.39.6/chop-linux-$ca" -o "$tmp" && printf '%s  %s\n' "$cs" "$tmp" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null && chmod 755 "$tmp" && mv -f "$tmp" "$HOME/.local/bin/chop"; fi; [ -x "$HOME/.local/bin/chop" ] && [ -f /usr/local/lib/jangada/agy-chop-hook.mjs ] && node /usr/local/lib/jangada/agy-chop-hook.mjs --register ) || true; }

description.pt: Agente do Google, sucessor do Gemini CLI.
description.en: Google's agent, successor to Gemini CLI.

note.pt: Entre com a conta Google; na primeira vez, o chat abre o terminal para colar o código.
note.en: Sign in with your Google account; the first time, the chat opens the terminal for you to paste the code.
